definitions.explanation: Relating to one's personal life as opposed to work or public life. Also describes something not open to the general public.

examples.japanese: プライベートな{質問|しつもん}はしないで。
{仕事|しごと}とプライベートを{分|わ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to keep work and my private life separate.

examples.japanese: プライベートでは{全然|ぜんぜん}{違|ちが}う{雰囲気|ふんいき}の{人|ひと}らしい。
examples.english: Apparently, in private they have a completely different vibe.

notes:
USAGE:
プライベート is one of the most common loanwords in daily Japanese. It typically contrasts with {仕事|しごと} (work) or {公|おおやけ} (public). When used as a noun, it means "one's private/personal life."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プライベートな{時間|じかん}: private/personal time
- プライベートを{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value one's private life
- {仕事|しごと}とプライベート: work and personal life
- プライベートビーチ: private beach
- プライベート{空間|くうかん}: private space

SIMILAR WORDS:
{私的|してき} (private/personal) is more formal. {個人的|こじんてき} (personal/individual) emphasizes individual opinion or circumstances. プライベート is the most natural choice when talking about work-life balance.
